background: UniCredit is Italy's second-largest bank and a leading lender in Germany, Austria and Central and Eastern Europe, funded by deposits across those markets, with a large stake in Commerzbank and a Russian subsidiary it has been winding down.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the bank at A- on average, one on a positive outlook and two stable, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 25 Nov 2025. Capital is on the weak side of EU and Nordic banks, with CET1 of 14.3% and leverage of 5.1% both below the median, and the trend is down: CET1 has fallen 1.8 points and leverage 0.6 points since 30 Jun 2025. Liquidity is mixed, with LCR of 140% in the bottom quarter and NSFR of 124% above the median, both broadly flat. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
